निर्गम

Translation status: हिन्दी reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the hi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Sets the exit code or exit expression for an entry point.

Syntax: आरंभ तर्क <name> निर्गम <expr> <block>

Category#

entry

Related#

  • आरंभasync

Sets the exit code or exit expression for an entry point.

# =============================================================================
# निर्गम — Sets the exit code or exit expression for an entry point
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Sets the exit code or exit expression for an entry point.
#   • Related keywords: आरंभ, आरंभasync, तर्क
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Using `इधरफेंको` without a `⇥` on the enclosing function — `इधरफेंको` requires an enclosing function with a `⇥` alternate-exit type (SEM010).
#
# See also: आरंभ, आरंभasync, तर्क
# =============================================================================

# निर्गम — CLI exit code on entry
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   entryModifier :← 'निर्गम' integer
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   No आरंभ — declaration or test-runner surface only.
#
# BACKEND:
#   declaration-only entry modifier (whitelist: निर्गम/exitus.fab).
#

@ cli { name = "exitus-smoke" }
main args args exit 1 {
}
